sql:
SELECT TEXT_ANALYZE(
  'I like pie, you like-pie, they like 2 PIEs.',
  analyzer=>'LOG_ANALYZER'
) AS results
shape: SELECT TEXT_ANALYZE('I like pie, you like-pie, they like 2 PIEs.', analyzer => 'LOG_ANALYZER') AS results;
SELECT TEXT_ANALYZE('I like pie, you like-pie, they like 2 PIEs.') AS results;

sql:
SELECT TEXT_ANALYZE(
  'I like pie, you like-pie, they like 2 PIEs.',
  analyzer=>'LOG_ANALYZER',
  analyzer_options=>'{"delimiters": [",", ".", "-"]}'
) AS results
shape: SELECT TEXT_ANALYZE('I like pie, you like-pie, they like 2 PIEs.', analyzer => 'LOG_ANALYZER', analyzer_options => '{"delimiters": [",", ".", "-"]}') AS results;

sql:
SELECT TEXT_ANALYZE(
  'I like pie, you like-pie, they like 2 PIEs.',
  analyzer=>'PATTERN_ANALYZER',
  analyzer_options=>'{"patterns": ["[a-zA-Z]*"]}'
) AS results
